import pandas as pd

def load(sheet):
    df = pd.read_excel('So_chi_tiet_ban_hang_1.xlsx', sheet_name=sheet)
    return df

def load2026(sheet):
    df = pd.read_excel('So_chi_tiet_ban_hang_2026.xlsx', sheet_name=sheet)
    return df

def revenue(df):
    # exclude cancelled and returned orders entirely
    keep = ~df['Trạng thái'].isin(['Đã hủy đơn','Hoàn trả'])
    d = df[keep].copy()
    d['Thành tiền'] = pd.to_numeric(d['Thành tiền'], errors='coerce')
    order = d.groupby('Mã đơn hàng')['Thành tiền'].sum()
    return order.sum()

r4 = revenue(load('T04_2026'))
r5 = revenue(load('T05_2026'))
r6 = revenue(load2026('T06_2026'))

print("Apr:", r4)
print("May:", r5)
print("Jun:", r6)
print("inc4->5:", r5-r4)
print("inc5->6:", r6-r5)
